# PRE-LAUNCH LOCKDOWN. This site is not public yet.
#
# Nothing here is meant to be crawled, indexed, or discoverable until the DNS
# cutover. Two separate locks are in place, and BOTH must be lifted at go-live:
#
#   1. this file          - Disallow: / below
#   2. _headers           - the X-Robots-Tag: noindex line on /*
#
# Note how they interact: a crawler that obeys Disallow never fetches the page,
# so it never sees the noindex header. Disallow alone does NOT guarantee a URL
# stays out of the index - Google can still list a bare URL it finds linked from
# somewhere else. That is why the noindex header stays on as well, and why the
# only real guarantee is putting the deployment behind Cloudflare Access.
#
# The sitemap is deliberately NOT advertised here, and sitemap.xml is not
# committed - it is a generated file, git-ignored until launch.

User-agent: *
Disallow: /
